The two frames were shot on the same fixture and are pixel-aligned, but their exposure differs slightly. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). (A) [0.4709, 0.5815, 0.6706, 0.7812]
(B) [0.7167, 0.6934, 0.9164, 0.8931]
(C) [0.2579, 0.1573, 0.4576, 0.3570]
(D) No defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
